preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MVK tokens to initiate the transfer
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true and contract must have accumulated enough tokens (contractTokenBalance > minTokensBeforeSwap)
Attacker must not be blocked (checkUserBlocked[attacker] = false) and must satisfy sell eligibility if selling to pair

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract with a fallback/receive function that reenters the _transfer function. Trigger a transfer that causes swapAndLiquify to execute, which calls pancakeRouter.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens. This external call can reenter through the receive() function. During reentrancy, manipulate state before the lockTheSwap modifier resets inSwapAndLiquify = false, potentially allowing multiple swaps or bypassing fee calculations. The attacker should aim to drain BNB from the contract's reward pool or marketing wallet transfers.
